theme_relationships.explanation: All-or-nothing thinking can exacerbate the struggle to separate self-worth from others' perceptions.
Past experiences can influence the struggle to separate self-worth from others' perceptions.
Past experiences can hinder the desire for self-acceptance and comfort in one's own skin.
The desire for self-acceptance and comfort in one's own skin can be influenced by social norms and expectations.
Social norms and expectations can impact the struggle to balance self-expression with social expectations.
Mindfulness can help balance self-expression with social expectations.
Mindfulness can reduce the impact of past experiences on current relationships and interactions.
Past experiences can influence the struggle to reconcile self-perception with others' perceptions.
The struggle to reconcile self-perception with others' perceptions can lead to all-or-nothing thinking.
